notes_for_editor: Thin record: the Forest Fire Lookout Association list gives only name, county, coordinates and gone status, and the compiled Central US Lookouts list agrees on Douglas County and nothing else. The first web search and the second turned up no build, staffing, design or removal details; the Stony Hill fire department history found in search is a different place and is not used. The statewide paragraph is context only; the 2015 and 2016 decommissioning dates disagree. No photos found. Worth checking Douglas County or Wisconsin DNR sources before publishing.
